confirmed: No preexisting arithmetic assignment was changed by the final patch; calls wrap observation around the R3 accumulation and snapshot existing arrays.

Line metadata stores five default INTEGER fields and eight REAL*8 fields in distinct COMMON blocks with matching declarations in writer/consumer. Stock GNU flags set default INTEGER and REAL to 8 bytes and record markers to 4 bytes.
Term record is 8-byte tag + 15 8-byte integers + 22 8-byte reals; snapshots are 8-byte tag + 19 8-byte integers + 5 8-byte reals, followed by one MAX3-element default-REAL R3 record.

IR4 starts at zero before the HIRAC1 data loop; ICNTNM, ILBLF4, IXSECT are from TAPE5/FSCDID. The XSECTM snapshots bracket the optional call. LNCOR1 populates per-line metadata before CNVFNV; CNVFNV stage 110/111 brackets every partial input chunk and records ILO/IHI/IPANEL.

The stage127 snapshot is after PANEL advances VFT and shifts R3. It describes the carried array in the new window. It should be joined to a subsequent stage110 record by sequence and VFT, not paired as though it shared stage126’s old origin. At positive target frequencies, no RSYM intervenes; R3 should remain unchanged from stage127 through the next stage110, providing a direct carry-integrity check.

Run parser must honor interleaved global sequence IDs for term and snapshot records; snapshots 110/111 repeat for each CNVFNV chunk.
